title: Tensor saturation for even spin groups
summary: We prove the saturation conjecture for $`\mathop{\mathrm{Spin}}\nolimits (2n)`$, n ≥ 2. If three dominant integral weights sum to an element of the root lattice, then the existence of a nonzero tensor invariant after a positive integral dilation implies the existence of one at the original weights.
family_title: Tensor saturation for even spin groups

review.reason: Proves the saturation conjecture for tensor invariants of Spin(2n) representations.
